materials.label: Copper
materials.description: A soft, conductive metal — prized for enchanted trinkets, poor as a blade.

materials.label: Bronze
materials.description: A workmanlike alloy of the early forges, holding an edge better than copper.

materials.label: Iron
materials.description: The reliable standard of arms and armor.

materials.label: Steel
materials.description: Refined iron — sharper, tougher, and the smith's preferred metal.

materials.label: Silver
materials.description: Conducts magic well and bites the undead and unholy.

materials.label: Gold
materials.description: Too soft for arms, but the finest conductor of magic — the enchanter's metal.

materials.label: Wood
materials.description: Common timber for hafts, bows, and shields — light and cheap.

materials.label: Elven Wood
materials.description: Living wood coaxed into shape by elven craft — light, resilient, and magically attuned.

materials.label: Obsidian
materials.description: Volcanic glass — wickedly sharp, but brittle and unfit for armor.

materials.label: Leather
materials.description: Cured animal hide. Common for light armor, straps, and flexible gear.

materials.label: Studded Leather
materials.description: Leather reinforced with brass or iron studs. More protective than raw hide while retaining flexibility.
